tara: Heads-up — quick UX callout: table row actions in Deployments view. Hover-only inline buttons feel hidden on trackpad. Thoughts on always-visible trailing actions on desktop but hidden on touch?
kevin: I ran into this — users miss the action menu. If we make them always-visible for dense rows, they take up space. Maybe collapse to icon-only ghost button? :thinking_face:
maya: Prefer icon-only trailing actions with hover labels. Also let's keep keyboard focus target to be the row itself not the action. Currently tab goes into kebab and traps focus.
ryan: Agree about focus trap. Proposed behavior: Tab lands on row; Enter opens row menu; arrow keys navigate actions. Screen readers should announce 'row actions collapsed' and expose the menu button.
tara: For tokens: can we use existing spacing tokens? e.g., row-padding: var(--space-3) -> 12px for comfortable hover area. If we reduce to space-2 density will harm hit target.
kevin: Implement suggestion, sample CSS snippet: ```css
.table-row { padding: var(--space-3); }
.row-actions { opacity: 0.88; }
.row-actions--dense { padding-inline: var(--space-1); }
``` Might need token rename if we add row-actions-spacing.
maya: Accessibility nit: tooltips need 500ms delay? also toasts are stealing focus when action triggers. toasts should be aria-live polite not assertive.
design-bot: Deploy preview updated: https://figma.com/file/xyz — includes icon-only trailing actions + keyboard flow. :robot_face:
ryan: One more: when a modal opens from action (confirm delete), ensure background row doesn't lose focus in a way that keyboard users can't return. Use focus-return pattern.
tara: :thumbsup: Let's prototype with always-visible icon-only actions on desktop, hover label, keep dense mode with larger touch targets. I'll update the spec and add an a11y checklist.
